name: CarX Real Drift Racing
summary: CarX Real Drift Racing 🚗💨 is a high-speed driving simulator built for drift lovers. Experience realistic car drifting, intense drift racing battles, and smooth driving physics in detailed environments 🌆. Master control, burn tires 🔥, and become the ultimate drift king 👑 in this action-packed racing game. Perfect for fans of drift car game, car racing, and driving simulator experiences.
